title: Blog/article web UI with reading view
description: Frontend: clean reading-focused UI for articles. Typography-first design (like Medium). Table of contents sidebar, estimated reading time, series navigation, author bio footer, related articles. Custom CSS per blog (WriteFreely feature). RSS/Atom feed per blog.
close_reason: Implemented: articles_db with 11 tests, writefreely_api types with 7 tests, handlers in all 3 servers (smallhold full CRUD, gaja multi-tenant, broadside read-only), schema migration v12
